description: On a sunny street of terraced houses, a young woman in paint-splattered white overalls stands on scaffolding with a roller, covering her mouth in shock. The view pulls back to show that the whole house has been painted bright pink, even its chimney, while the grey house next door is untouched. Another painter in overalls stands by the gate below, a woman looks out of the door, and on the pavement a young man in a straw hat and neck pillow, with two suitcases, stares up at the pink house.

en.question: What is the woman on top doing?
